Name: Baruch
Summary: Baruch, son of Neriah, was Jeremiah's scribe. He wrote Jeremiah's words in a roll, read them in the temple, rewrote the scroll after Jehoiakim burned it, bought the field at Anathoth as witness to the promise, and was carried to Egypt with Jeremiah. When he despaired of his own sorrows, God told him to seek not great things for himself.
KeyStory: Baruch wrote at Jeremiah's mouth all the words of the Lord in a roll, read it in the Lord's house, and wrote it again after the king burned it, with many like words added.
KeyVerses: Jeremiah 32:12-16; Jeremiah 36:4-32; Jeremiah 43:1-7; Jeremiah 45:1-5; Nehemiah 10:6; Nehemiah 11:5
RelatedPeople: Jeremiah; Seraiah, Son of Neriah; Johanan, Son of Kareah
LifeLesson: Faithful writing and reading of God's word is ministry, even when the king burns the book.
